note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions and the two cited guides. Stage trophy lists are the trophy ids from data/trophies.json.

stages.summary: Play the campaign at your leisure and let the story trophies come to you. Twelve of the 55 pop from the story alone, and the character strands open as you go. The only thing you must not put off is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.
tips: Make a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay, and 15 save slots are plenty for a safety net.
After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and meditate with her on the balcony. It is the one potentially missable moment in the whole list.
Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars from the start — the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles and 100 animal species, and collecting them naturally saves hours later.
Never turn cheats on: they disable trophies and saving while active.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

stages.summary: After the finale, the 100% Completion Checklist opens (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Work it in order: robberies first, then collectibles, then activities. You do not have to do literally everything — 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges are enough.
tips: Robberies: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and all 8 bank vaults. The vaults open through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…
Collectibles: 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets.
Activities: 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 30 races won, 70 challenges, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Skip what the checklist does not ask for — hunting all 255 animals or finishing every card set wastes hours.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Reach 100% completion

stages.summary: With the story done and 100% in the bag, check the trophy list for what is left. Most of it is character questlines and one-off miscellaneous trophies that are not on the completion checklist. Finish them, then the platinum pops.
tips: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands.
Mop up the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude if you have not already.
Clear the combat and crime trophies: the 4-star escape, the shop robberies, the tank, the jewelry store and the armored truck.
Check the list one last time — then Vice Got a Price! is yours.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Clean up the stragglers
